app.title: Sealed Heaven — C0.4 First Playable
help.controls: Click NPC / Tab: select. Space: pause/resume. N: single step. F5: save. F9: load. R: reset demo. L: language. WASD / arrows: pan. Q/E: zoom. C: reset camera.
help.inspector: Scroll here with the mouse wheel; Page Up/Down, Home/End navigate the inspector.
help.needs: Needs show stored decision channels, not a live decay simulation. Channels do not decay in this demo. Food and cargo are not automatically replenished.
help.travel: Positions come from the checkpoint. Marker offsets only avoid overlap. A cost-1 journey can arrive in one logical tick; movement is not smooth physics.
help.save: Save stores the canonical checkpoint at the application save path. Load and reset pause the simulation. Language, selection, camera and recent event history are not saved.
inspector.title: World inspector
